title: No arcane cortical mechanism is needed

statements.text: Because the approach explains phenomenology in everyday descriptions of sensorimotor interaction, it needs no appeal to quantum effects in microtubules, information integration or cortico-thalamic reverberation, which have no intelligible link to the qualities of experience.

sources.quote: does not need to appeal to arcane cortical mechanisms like quantum gravity effects in microtubules, information integration or cortico-thalamic reverberations
